remarks: RARELY does a unit become available! 1/2 mile from many favorite Norwalk Stores/Rte 1/Restaurants and 2.5 miles from Westport Center. Welcome to this bright and airy, well maintained 2 bed/2.5 bath Townhouse in the sought after quiet setting of Strawberry Woods. This updated ready to move-in condo offers 2 large Bedroom ensuites w/ dual closets. The Primary boasts vaulted ceiling, skylights, Private Balcony and a 50" mounted TV. Main Floor offers an Eat-in Kitchen, custom built dry bar/pantry, SS appliances, private balcony perfect for dining/relaxing and overlooking a luscious tree lined backyard, a Powder Room, a spacious Living Room and Dining area w/wood-burning Fireplace. Option to convert electric range to a gas unit per H.O.A. bylaws. The Entry-level offers Bonus Room (Office/Gym/Media/Playroom) w/built ins, complete w/Large Storage and Laundry Room & access to the under unit Garage. HUGE clean Attic. Central Air. Plenty of storage throughout. Curtains and new window shades included. This manicured property offers a lovely Community Pool, a Reserved Parking Spot & ample Visitor Parking. Close to Bus line, Grocery stores, Retail shops, Restaurants, Arts, Calf Pasture Beach(Playground/Fishing Pier/Cafe), Park Concerts, Oak Hills Public Golf Course. Easy access to Post Rd, I-95 & 2 RRs. 50 miles from NYC. Painting exterior of all buildings NOW. All paving completed.
